title: PowerFlex 525 fault F004
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F004. DC bus undervoltage: inspect incoming AC line for low voltage or interruption. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_LOW_LINE.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F005
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F005. DC bus overvoltage: inspect high line voltage or transients and consider motor regeneration and deceleration time. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_HIGH_LINE_REGEN.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F008
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F008. Heatsink or power-module over-temperature: inspect heatsink blockage, rated ambient temperature, and fan. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_HEATSINK_COOLING.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F009
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F009. Control-module over-temperature: inspect ambient temperature, airflow obstruction, debris, and fan. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_CONTROL_COOLING.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F006
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F006. Motor stall during acceleration or deceleration: inspect load and acceleration time/current-limit settings. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_STALL_ACCEL_LOAD.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F007
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F007. Motor electronic overload: inspect excess load relative to P033 Motor OL Current and A530 Boost Select. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_MOTOR_OVERLOAD.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F021
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F021. Output phase loss when that protection is enabled: verify motor wiring and motor; A557 controls the feature. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_OUTPUT_PHASE.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F029
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F029. Analog input loss where configured to fault: inspect input connections and t094/t097 signal-loss parameters. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_ANALOG_INPUT.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F003
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F003. Power loss associated with single-phase operation and load: inspect incoming line, input fuses, and load. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_POWER_FUSES_LOAD.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F064
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F064. Drive overload rating exceeded: inspect load and acceleration time. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_DRIVE_OVERLOAD.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F071
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F071. Modbus or DSI network control interrupted: inspect communications cabling, Modbus/DSI settings and status. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_DSI_NETWORK.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F072
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F072. Network option card remote control interrupted: inspect cabling, adapter settings, and external network status. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_OPTION_NETWORK.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F073
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F073. Embedded EtherNet/IP control interrupted: inspect cabling, EtherNet/IP settings, and external network status. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_EMBEDDED_ETHERNET.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F081
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F081. Communication with Modbus or DSI master interrupted: inspect cabling, settings, status, and C125 Comm Loss Action. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_DSI_MASTER_COMM.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F082
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F082. Drive-to-network-option-card communication lost: inspect/reseat the option card and C125 Comm Loss Action. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_OPTION_CARD_LINK.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F083
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F083. Internal communication with embedded EtherNet/IP adapter lost: inspect Ethernet settings, diagnostic parameters, and C125. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_EMBEDDED_ADAPTER_LINK.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F059
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F059. Safety Open: both safety inputs are not enabled; inspect safety input signals and t105 configuration. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_SAFETY_INPUT_STATUS.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F111
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F111. Safety input hardware malfunction: inspect safety signals; if fault persists, service the control module. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_SAFETY_HARDWARE.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F106
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F106. PowerFlex 525 control module does not support a 0.25 HP power module; check module compatibility, with a compatible power module or PowerFlex 523 control module as documented options. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_025HP_INCOMPATIBILITY.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F107
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F107. Control module cannot recognize the power module: check power module, then control module if the fault persists. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_UNRECOGNIZED_MODULE.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F125
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F125. Firmware corrupt, mismatched, or hardware-incompatible: attempt a valid firmware flash update. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_FIRMWARE_FLASH.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F127
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F127. Critical firmware fault with DSI-only backup firmware: attempt a valid firmware flash update through DSI communications. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_DSI_FIRMWARE_FLASH.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F015
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F015. Load-loss threshold/time met: inspect motor-to-load connection and A490/A491 settings. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_LOAD_LOSS.

title: PowerFlex 525 fault F063
text: Applicable model: PowerFlex 525. Displayed fault: F063. Software shear-pin threshold/time met: inspect motor-to-load connection and A486-A489 settings. Diagnostic action ID: CHECK_SHEAR_PIN_LIMIT.
